subject: environmental-science
title: Weather & Climate: Climate Change
welcome_lead: Earth's climate is warming — and human activity is the main reason.
meta_desc: KS3 environmental science: greenhouse effect, global warming.
final_note: Less burning, more trees, more change of slowing it.

concepts.def: Gases trapping heat in the atmosphere.
Gas like CO2 that traps heat.
Strong greenhouse gas from cattle and waste.

walkthroughs.body_html: Sunlight warms Earth. Some heat escapes back to space. Greenhouse gases like CO2 trap part of it, keeping Earth liveable. Too much trapping warms it more.
Burning fossil fuels adds CO2. Cattle and rice fields add methane. Cutting forests removes the trees that take CO2 in.
Warmer seas, melting ice, stronger storms and rising sea levels. Many species are moving or shrinking.
